browser_requirements: overview points use width_m and width_valid
no coverage-only layer in new overview
wide symbols larger than narrow symbols
exact source attribute lookup from overview ID
visual review of Mississippi, world, Amazon, dateline and z7 to z8

overview.anchor: First vertex of the first nonempty original part of each source record. No new line connections.
overview.buffer_rule: Duplicate winners into neighboring tile buffers after selection; wrap x, bound y; retain ID and attributes.
overview.coarsening: Exact maximum-priority winner of each 2x2 cell block, through zoom 0.
overview.feature_id: Original source feature_id in the MVT feature ID.
overview.geometry: Point anchored on original geometry; quantized only for display.
overview.label: Selected observations; widest measured width per screen-scale cell.
overview.projection: Spherical Web Mercator, clamp latitude to atan(sinh(pi)); x periodic, y bounded. Normalized coordinates rounded half-up to 2^28 integer lattice; bin by high bits, southern edge assigned last cell.
selection: smallest feature_id for ties and all-unknown cells
overview.symbol: Circle diameter equals detailed width stroke; unknown sentinel muted; same capped width legend at every zoom.

purpose: Show source width differences at all map zooms while preserving the validated analytical data and detailed tile payloads.
